content:
Join RoyalDogs Casino and discover over 7,000 games, sports betting and a variety of exciting bonuses! Explore popular slots, join live dealer tables and get started with a 777% welcome package worth up to €10,000 across your first five deposits. We've brought together a wide range of entertainment, so you can discover new games and return to your favourites whenever you like.

There's even more waiting for you at Royal Dogs! Open Mystery Boxes in Doggy Drops, unlock exclusive perks through our The Dog House loyalty programme and enjoy regular offers for active players. Choose the games you love, discover new rewards and enjoy every moment at your own pace.

Doggy Drops

Love a surprise? Head over to Doggy Drops and open Mystery Boxes containing cash prizes and Free Spins. You can purchase boxes using Shop Coins, with prices starting from 30 CAD. Choose an available box, open it and discover your reward. The contents of each box remain a mystery until you open it.

In the Your Available Boxes section, you'll find the boxes ready for you to open. These include Royal Drop, while members of The Dog House loyalty programme can unlock access to improved Doggy Drops. Check your available gifts in your account and choose which boxes you'd like to open next.

RoyalDogs VIP Club

Join The Dog House, our loyalty programme featuring five levels: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum and Diamond. Your journey begins at Bronze, and you'll earn experience points (XP) by placing real-money wagers. Collect XP, move up through the levels and unlock additional rewards. Your progress depends on your gaming activity, with new perks becoming available as your status increases.

Moving up the VIP ranks brings even more benefits. These include weekly cashback, personalised bonuses, increased withdrawal limits, priority withdrawal processing and higher bonus betting limits. At higher levels, you can also gain access to a personal VIP manager, 24/7 support, exclusive raffles and tailored deposit offers.

We've created several ways to reward your activity in The Dog House. Weekly Cashback lets eligible VIP members receive a percentage of their losses back at the end of each week. Monthly Bonus offers an additional reward based on your monthly activity, while Level Up Bonus celebrates each new milestone. You can also try the Wheel of Fortune for a chance to win cash bonuses, Free Spins or the jackpot. As you play, you'll collect RoyalDogs Points, which can be exchanged for real money in the Bonus Shop.

VIP Club members can enjoy a separate Slots Package featuring five offers. The first bonus provides 200% up to €10,000, followed by 250% up to €12,000, 300% up to €12,000, 250% up to €12,000 and 350% up to €15,000. Together, these offers make up a VIP package of 1350% up to €61,000. Access to individual offers depends on your loyalty status.

Casino Games at Royal Dogs

Choose from over 7,000 games, ranging from classic slots to modern titles featuring cascading wins, multipliers and bonus rounds. Gates of Olympus offers the chance to land multipliers during spins, while Sweet Bonanza combines cascading symbols with Free Spins. If you enjoy adventure-themed slots, try Book of Dead or Legacy of Dead. Big Bass Bonanza brings fishing-themed action, while The Dog House Megaways and Buffalo King Megaways feature mechanics with a variable number of ways to win.

We've brought together games from Pragmatic Play, Play'n GO, Spinomenal, PG Soft, Amatic Industries and Endorphina. With so many developers to explore, you can discover slots featuring unique mechanics, traditional reels and modern bonus features. Use the search function to find your favourite games by title or developer.

New players can enjoy RoyalDogs Welcome Offers, featuring five slot bonuses. Your first deposit comes with 250% up to €2,500, followed by 100% up to €1,500 on your second, 150% up to €2,000 on your third, 100% up to €3,000 on your fourth and 177% up to €1,000 on your fifth. Altogether, the welcome package offers 777% up to €10,000. Each offer can be unlocked separately through its corresponding Slots Package.

For returning players, we've prepared Weekly Reload with four promotions throughout the week. Monday brings Pitbull's Monday with 100% up to €1,000, while Wednesday features Lassie's Wednesday with 250% up to €1,500. On Friday, you can claim Friday Treat with 200% up to €2,000, followed by Bulldog's Saturday offering 100% up to €3,500. The complete weekly package adds up to 650% up to €8,000. Choose the promotion available on your preferred day and check its terms before claiming.

Live Casino Games

Join our live dealer tables and enjoy classic casino games streamed in real time. In our Live Casino, you can choose roulette, blackjack or baccarat. Place bets on individual numbers, colours or groups of numbers in roulette, aim for a hand closer to 21 without going over in blackjack, or follow the Player and Banker hands in baccarat. Professional dealers host each session live, letting you watch every stage of the game as it happens.

Alongside the classics, we've added a variety of other live games. Try 360 Blackjack Midnight, Sunrise or Sunset for a different take on the traditional blackjack experience. You can also explore Top Card Live and other presenter-hosted games. Before joining a table, you can check the rules and available betting options.

Crash Games

If you enjoy quick rounds, explore our selection of Crash Games. Try Aviator, where the multiplier increases as the plane flies higher. Your aim is to cash out before the round ends. The exact moment the flight finishes is unpredictable, so the outcome of each bet depends on when you choose to cash out.

We've also added Dice, Goal, Hotline, Keno and Mines. In Dice, the result is determined by a random dice roll, Keno challenges you to pick numbers, while Mines lets you reveal tiles while avoiding hidden mines. Each game has its own rules and mechanics, but they all offer short rounds with quick results.

Sports Betting at RoyalDogs

Follow your favourite teams and place bets on sporting events with Royal Dogs! Our sportsbook covers football, basketball, tennis, ice hockey, volleyball, handball and many other sports. Football fans can explore fixtures from the Champions League, Europa League, English Premier League, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga and Ligue 1. Basketball enthusiasts can follow NBA games, while our E-Sports category features competitive gaming events.

We offer a variety of betting markets, including match winners, double chance, handicaps and totals. The Enhanced Odds section features selected events with boosted odds, while the Hot label highlights special sporting opportunities. If a match is already underway, head to Live Now to follow the action and place bets at odds that change as the event unfolds.

To place a bet, select an event and click your preferred odds. Your selection will appear in the Betslip, where you can review your bet before confirming it. My Bets keeps a record of your placed bets, while Results lets you check completed matches. If you have a booking code, enter it in the Booking Code field to load your bet slip.

RoyalDogs Mobile Gaming

Enjoy your favourite games on your smartphone with the RoyalDogs Casino mobile app. We've made our casino games and sporting events accessible on mobile, allowing you to switch between slots, live casino and the sportsbook without using a computer. The app also lets you manage your account, explore active promotions, check your rewards and follow your progress in The Dog House.

If you'd rather not install the app, simply open our website in your mobile browser. Sign in to your account and access the main casino sections without downloading additional software. A stable internet connection is required, and the availability of certain features may depend on your device and browser.

Deposits and Withdrawals

Make deposits and request withdrawals through the Royal Dogs cashier. We support cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Tether, Dogecoin, Cardano, Dash and NEO. Available currencies and payment methods depend on your country and account settings. When making a deposit, you can check the current payment options, minimum amounts and other transaction details directly in the cashier.

For cryptocurrency deposits, choose your preferred currency, check the transfer network and use the current wallet address. Funds are credited to your gaming balance once the transaction has been processed. Deposits must be made using payment methods registered in your own name, and applicable limits may vary depending on the method selected.

The minimum withdrawal amount is €100, with a daily limit of €1,000 and a weekly limit of €2,000. You can request one withdrawal every 24 hours, with only one pending request permitted per payment method. Withdrawals are processed according to our established procedures and the requirements of the chosen payment provider. Before requesting a withdrawal, the total amount wagered from your deposit must be at least 100% of the deposited funds.

To help protect transactions, we carry out Know Your Customer (KYC) verification. This is required when requesting a withdrawal, once cumulative deposits exceed €2,000, or when a transaction requires additional checks. You may be asked to provide a valid identity document, a selfie holding that document, proof of address and confirmation of your payment method. Document checks are typically completed within 48 working hours, provided no further information is required.

RoyalDogs Casino Registration

To create an account at RoyalDogs Casino, click Sign Up and complete the registration form. We'll ask for your real name, email address, telephone number, username and password. All details must be accurate, as they may be used for identity verification and account security. Registration is available to players aged 18 or over, or older where local laws require a higher minimum gambling age.

If you already have an account, click Sign In and enter your login details. Keep your password private and never allow anyone else to use your account. If you forget your password, use Forgot Password to reset it. If we detect suspicious activity, we may request additional verification to help protect your account.

Responsible Gaming at Royal Dogs

We support responsible gambling and want every gaming session to remain an enjoyable form of entertainment. Never treat betting as a way to earn an income or solve financial difficulties. Set your budget before playing, keep track of your spending and take regular breaks. Avoid chasing losses or gambling with money needed for everyday expenses.

At Royal Dogs, you can use tools to manage your gaming activity, including deposit, betting, loss and session time limits. If you need a short break, you can activate a Cool-down period lasting from 1 to 48 hours. During this time, deposits and betting are suspended, while withdrawals remain available. Temporary and indefinite self-exclusion options are also available. If gambling stops being enjoyable or becomes difficult to control, you can seek support from organisations such as Gamblers Anonymous or Gambling Therapy.

mainEntity.name: How can I unlock improved Doggy Drops?

acceptedAnswer.text: Improved Doggy Drops are among the perks available through The Dog House loyalty programme. Access depends on your VIP level and the rewards unlocked in your account. You can check your available boxes in the Your Available Boxes section.

mainEntity.name: Can I activate multiple bonuses at the same time?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, only one bonus can be active at a time. Before activating another offer, you must complete or finish using your current bonus according to its terms.

mainEntity.name: Can I exchange RoyalDogs Points for real money?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can exchange your accumulated RoyalDogs Points for real money in the Bonus Shop. The number of points available depends on your gaming activity.

mainEntity.name: Can I cancel a withdrawal request?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. If you cancel a withdrawal request, the funds are returned to your gaming balance. You can then submit a new request, subject to the applicable daily, weekly and other payment limits.

mainEntity.name: Can I place bets while a match is in progress?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Open Live Now and select a sporting event that has already started. Available markets and odds may change throughout the match as the action unfolds.

mainEntity.name: What happens after I activate self-exclusion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your account will be restricted for the selected period. During this time, you won't be able to sign in, make deposits or place bets. The chosen self-exclusion period cannot be shortened or cancelled before it expires.
